I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.title: Z close audit_logs cross-chain anchor (K2-HEAL-06)
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.evidence_summary: Z-close did NOT write any audit_logs HMAC anchor entry — only logged to file channel 'fiscal'. NF525 chain had Z-chain (z_reports.signature) AND audit_logs chain but no cross-chain anchor binding the two. Forensic concern: a Z-close had no audit_logs row, so an audit_logs walk alone could not detect Z-close existence. Heal applied via ZReport::updated Eloquent hook in AppServiceProvider::boot, wrapping the FROZEN ZReportService without touching it.
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.trigger_gating: ZReport::updated hook with 3-step gate: wasChanged('status') + status === STATUS_CLOSED + non-null signature (belt-and-suspenders against future save paths that flip CLOSED without signature)
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.why_updated_not_created: open() calls ZReport::create() with status=OPEN and no signature, while close() reuses the same row via $open->forceFill(...)->save() → close event is an UPDATE on the existing OPEN row (line 96-101 of source comment)
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.frozen_zone_compliance: ZReportService.php is FROZEN §7 — NOT modified. Hook applied at Eloquent model layer (ZReport.php, not frozen) wrapping frozen service without touching it (line 90-93 of source comment).
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.best_effort_wrap: try/catch + Log::warning — matches CashDrawerService::writeAuditLog pattern. Cache outage failing audit append MUST NOT abort Z close itself (Z-chain via z_reports.signature still valid; cross-chain anchor is forensic-only).
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.forensic_walker_use: audit_logs walk now sees z_report.closed events → forensic reconciler can cross-reference audit_logs.payload.z_report_id ↔ z_reports.id without inferring closure existence from secondary signals.
I5_z_close_audit_logs_anchor.gaps: Cross-chain anchor is forensic-only — its absence is NOT a fiscal break (Z-chain integrity remains via z_reports.signature HMAC). Best-effort wrap is correct posture: a Z close MUST succeed even if audit append fails.
